notes: This is the MCP example server's page, identical in layout to the PDF viewer one. A white card on a black page shows the MCP logo and 'Authorization Required: This client wants to connect to your MCP server'. The client is shown only as a raw UUID in a monospace box. A 'What happens next?' note describes a redirect to the upstream provider, and a single black 'Continue to Authentication' button follows, with no Deny option and no permissions listed.
